official_sources.title: Link [link]
official_sources.classification: Explicit best practice, not a bullet in Minimum requirements. Examples nevertheless instruct automatic selection.
official_sources.minimum_paraphrase: Supply a crawlable product URL on the verified domain that works on desktop/mobile; free-listing clicks use link/mobile_link. The minimum list does not separately mandate preselection.

official_sources.title: About landing page requirements
official_sources.sections: Minimum requirements: Show your product clearly; Best practices
official_sources.minimum_paraphrase: For ads and free listings, the linked variant must be readily identifiable and primary, with matching product details and a clear feed-matching price/currency. Other displayed prices must be distinguishable. Purchasable items need an active buying control or equivalent ordering route; the page must work on mobile.
official_sources.best_practice: Correct default variant selection is explicitly a best practice.
official_sources.scope_caveat: The separate stable-landing-page rule explicitly limits itself to Shopping-ad traffic. Do not silently extend that rule to organic traffic or erase the general free-listing matching and clarity requirements.

official_sources.title: Price [price]
official_sources.sections: Minimum requirements; Tax: value added tax
official_sources.minimum_paraphrase: Submitted amount/currency must match landing and checkout; show target currency prominently. Variants and their prices must be straightforward. AU prices include applicable GST. A price range is not categorically banned, but cannot substitute for unambiguous identification of the submitted variant price.

official_sources.title: Availability [availability]
official_sources.minimum_paraphrase: Availability must agree across feed, visible page, structured data if present, and checkout. In-stock offers need a functional purchase control and must be fulfillable/shippable to supported destinations. This defines ability to fulfill orders, not ownership of physical inventory.

official_sources.title: Free listings for products
official_sources.sections: Eligibility and requirements; Provide the required product attributes
official_sources.minimum_paraphrase: Free listings require policy-compliant product attributes and AU shipping settings or product shipping costs. Website returns information is required; adding the return policy within Merchant is recommended. Free-listing permission does not guarantee display.

official_sources.title: Editorial & technical requirements
official_sources.minimum_paraphrase: Free listings require compliant product data and relevant, usable, functional landing pages. Difficult navigation or inability to complete a purchase can be disallowed.

official_sources.title: Checkout requirements and best practices
official_sources.sections: Allow everyone to check out; Provide accurate pricing
official_sources.minimum_paraphrase: Customers must be able to add available items and complete purchase; the product price remains consistent into cart and checkout. Required non-government fees must be disclosed in the applicable shipping costs.

official_sources.title: Availability-mismatch troubleshooting answer
official_sources.paraphrase: This corrective guidance directs each variant URL to a pre-populated variant page. Its stronger wording makes preselection the safer mismatch remedy, while the governing link/landing specifications label it a best practice. It is not evidence that this account has an AU availability violation.
